title: Rainy Cowboy with Bull
description: A lone cowboy wearing a dark poncho and ornate black hat with gold stars and dripping horns stands in heavy rain. He holds a coiled lasso in one hand while resting the other on a large dark bull beside him, with a white bird perched on his shoulder amid a desolate barbed wire fence landscape.
